title: The Aftermath of the reservoir
author: Y. M. Eriksen
blurb: Ulyana Nystrom, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
